So remaining fuel = fuel_range / (average_consumption per km). 560 km * (8.2 L/100km) = 560 * 0.082 = 45.92 liters. Convert to gallons: 45.92 L / 3.785 = 12.13 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So need to add 50 - 12.13 = 37.87 gallons. We'll round to 37.9 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 37.9.")
